description: Register a new Keywordise account from the terminal and receive an API key for it. Requires accept_terms=true: the person accepts the Terms and Privacy Policy (https://keywordise.com/terms) and authorises Keywordise to apply for jobs on their behalf. A confirmation email is sent; applying opens once the address is confirmed. Trial: 7 days and 27 applications, then $49/month.
name: create_account
title: Create a Keywordise account
